title: Dynamic Theory: a machine-verified reconstruction (Lean 4/Mathlib proofs and assertion-driven SageMath scripts)
description: Verification corpus for the Dynamic Theory of Pharis E. Williams (LA-8370-MS, 1980). Two verification layers, Lean 4 / Mathlib proofs and assertion-driven SageMath / SymPy scripts, organised by the three-layer reading of the Chapter-1 flow chart, with run logs and a per-layer index. Accompanies the manuscript "Dynamic Theory: Reconstruction, Verification, and Experimental Predictions".
